title: Methods without explicit retrieval
caption: Complete comparison of 29 methods without explicit retrieval, grouped by their primary single-page or multipage setting. Ordering and first-release dates follow Table 1 (representative explicit-retrieval methods). + denotes combinations and / alternatives; -- denotes unconfirmed information.

conventions.ordering: Source row order is preserved. Within task groups, methods follow final conference submission deadlines, then first release within each conference; preprints/journal papers are inserted by first release (Table 1 convention).
conventions.dates: First release is separate from the citation year in the current BibTeX. YY.MM preferentially denotes the first arXiv version; an earlier official release, or the official release when no preprint exists, takes precedence. A -- month is unavailable and is stored as null, never as an invented month.
conventions.venue_superscripts: Venue superscripts F/W/D/S/I/C mean Findings, Workshop, Datasets and Benchmarks, Short, Industry, and competition reports, respectively.
conventions.superscripts: Plain JSON/CSV uses ^(x); Markdown displays x as a superscript.

notes: 1. Methods. * marks methods primarily evaluated on single pages/images that also support multiple pages. Venue superscripts follow Table 4 (benchmark catalog); (YY.MM) denotes first release, and -- in the month position means unavailable. Deep = Deep Parsing; Eval. = Evaluation.
2. Model and learning. Model gives the main answer model or language-backbone family. Learning records added Pretraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), or reinforcement learning (RL).

3. Evaluation. Ans./Ret./Loc./Eff./Rob. denote answer quality/retrieval/localization/efficiency/robustness. Only dimensions quantitatively reported in the original paper are listed. Ret. denotes page-level evidence selection or prediction and does not imply explicit retrieval in the answering pipeline. Exceptions (a): LayoutLMv3 Loc. is layout-box detection; VinQA (Page Encoding) Ret. is element-citation F1; CoE Loc. includes box-center hits; M3Grounder and DoCoG Loc. include segmentation masks.
